name: horizontal-object-demo
research_question: How does the selected simulation backend respond when a small object crosses the fixed visual corridor?
hypothesis: The selected neural or motor output changes after the object begins its left-to-right sweep.
success_criteria: The two corridor walls and fly pose remain fixed throughout the trial.
The object moves from the fly's left side to right side at constant azimuth speed between the walls.
The exact per-step neural input, readouts, motor output, stimulus state, and world state are recorded.
This demo protocol is not evidence of biological validity.
notes: Pilot scaffold only. The walls are visual context with collisions disabled. The fixed-radius path keeps nominal viewing distance and angular object size stable. Eye position and retinal mapping are not calibrated. Response latency is not automatically computed until a response channel and onset threshold are specified; motor output is recorded but not applied to the fly.
